title: neonauclea hagenii subsp. papuana
intro: Neonauclea hagenii subsp. papuana, commonly known as the Papuan Neonauclea, is a species of plant in the Rubiaceae family. The Papuan Neonauclea plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. Research has shown that the bioactive constituents of Neonauclea hagenii subsp. papuana, such as flavonoids and alkaloids, exhibit therapeutic actions including antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities. The plant's bioactive constituents may also have potential in the development of new treatments for various diseases due to their ability to modulate various biological pathways.
